NO WHISPERS FROM A BLACK BOX

A small forest. Every branch inspectable.

What is actually AI here?

A scikit-learn Isolation Forest, trained on 2,048 fictional records. Its 48 fitted trees are exported into this page. The browser walks those trees for every new record. This is inference, not a prerecorded answer or a generative chatbot.

Where does your data go?

Nowhere beyond this page. There are no analytics, remote inference, cookies, or localStorage writes. A chosen file is read into browser memory. Clear the session or close the tab to remove the working view. Exports happen only when requested.

What the scores cannot say

The threshold is calibrated on synthetic training data. Novel sources, events, or schedules can be flagged even when they are ordinary in your world. This is an explainable demonstration—not a security product, a prediction of wrongdoing, or a validated detector for your data.

Training and synthetic validation notes

Synthetic checks only. No human study or production validation. Feature notes are deterministic comparisons with the training baseline, not SHAP values.
